settings.custom_description: Multi-Comfort 20210 combines motorized height adjustment with an adjustable headrest and manually adjustable backrest and legrest for facials and hair removal. Its 15° tilt helps provide access to the face and neck areas.

settings.secondary_description: Ultra-white, ultra-resistant leatherette is offered in Color Chart A. The catalog lists 24-inch and 28-inch widths with optional removable armrests; this product’s selectors show the currently offered 24-inch White variant.
